The broken protocol calls `await lh.aspirate(...)` without first attaching a tip — PyLabRobot's simulation raises a "no tip on pipette" error because aspiration is physically impossible (and blocked by the backend) when `pick_up_tips` has not been called.     tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")

    # FIX: The broken protocol aspirated without a tip attached, causing
    # the simulation to fail with a "no tip" error. Always pick up tips
    # BEFORE any aspiration.
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A1"])

    # Transfer 100 uL from source well A1 to destination well A1
    await lh.aspirate(source["A1"], vols=[100])
    await lh.dispense(dest["A1"], vols=[100])

    # Drop tips after dispensing to leave the pipette clean
    await lh.drop_tips()

    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")

    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    TEST_VOL = 40  # uL — safely within the 50 uL tip capacity
    results = {}

    print("Starting protocol validation tests...")

    # --- Test 1: pick_up_tips --------------------------------------------
    try:
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A1"])
        tips_attached = True

    try:

            try:
                await lh.aspirate(source["A1"], vols=[TEST_VOL])
                results["aspirate"] = "PASS"
            except Exception as e:
                results["aspirate"] = f"FAIL: {e}"

            try:
                await lh.dispense(dest["A1"], vols=[TEST_VOL])
                results["dispense"] = "PASS"
            except Exception as e:
                results["dispense"] = f"FAIL: {e}"

            # --- Test 4: mix (aspirate + dispense in place) ----------------
            try:
                # Default mix cycles used for maximum version compatibility
                await lh.mix(dest["A1"], vols=[TEST_VOL])
                results["mix"] = "PASS"
            except Exception as e:
                results["mix"] = f"FAIL: {e}"

                await lh.aspirate(trough["A1"], vols=[TEST_VOL])
                await lh.dispense(dest["B1"], vols=[TEST_VOL])
                results["trough_access"] = "PASS"

                results["trough_access"] = f"FAIL: {e}"

            # --- Test 6: drop_tips (return tips to original spot) ----------
            try:
                await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["A1"])
                tips_attached = False
                results["drop_tips"] = "PASS"
            except Exception as e:

            results["mix"] = "SKIPPED: no tips attached"
